requirements.sourceQuote: Academic admission requirements include a completed Bachelor’s degree in the field of electrical engineering, electronics, computer science or any other related field of study with a final grade of at least 2.5 (German grading system) and 210 ECTS (corresponding to a four-year full time study programme).
